name: [Part 1] exact closed-window cutoff
test:
tracker = RecentInteractionTracker()
tracker.process_event('u', 'c', 0)
tracker.process_event('u', 'c', 14)
assert tracker.get_num_recent_interactions('u', 'c') == 2
tracker.process_event('u', 'c', 15)
assert tracker.get_num_recent_interactions('u', 'c') == 2
tracker.process_event('other', 'chat', 16)
assert tracker.get_num_recent_interactions('u', 'c') == 2
assert tracker.get_num_recent_interactions('missing', 'chat') == 0

name: [Part 1] ordered contract and global eviction
input: decreasing timestamp and a far-future unrelated key
test:
tracker = RecentInteractionTracker()
tracker.process_event('stale', 'chat', 1)
tracker.process_event('new', 'chat', 30)
assert tracker.get_num_recent_interactions('stale', 'chat') == 0
try:
    tracker.process_event('u', 'c', 29)
    assert False, 'expected ValueError'
except ValueError:
    pass

name: [Part 2] end deactivates and later interaction reactivates
input: two chats with repeated interaction, end, and reactivation
test:
tracker = OrderedActiveSessionTracker()
tracker.process_event('u', 'c1', 0, 'interact')
tracker.process_event('u', 'c1', 5, 'interact')
tracker.process_event('u', 'c2', 6, 'interact')
assert tracker.get_num_active_sessions('u') == 2
tracker.process_event('u', 'c1', 7, 'end')
assert tracker.get_num_active_sessions('u') == 1
tracker.process_event('u', 'c1', 8, 'interact')
assert tracker.get_num_active_sessions('u') == 2

name: [Part 2] sessions expire at the exact boundary
input: interactions at 6 and 8 while time advances to 22 and 23
test:
tracker = OrderedActiveSessionTracker()
tracker.process_event('u', 'c2', 6, 'interact')
tracker.process_event('u', 'c1', 8, 'interact')
tracker.process_event('other', 'x', 22, 'interact')
assert tracker.get_num_active_sessions('u') == 1
tracker.process_event('other', 'x', 23, 'end')
assert tracker.get_num_active_sessions('u') == 0

name: [Part 3] bounded lateness buffers then finalizes events
input: interact at 10, end at 12, late interact at 11
test:
tracker = OutOfOrderActiveSessionTracker(window=15, allowed_lateness=2)
assert tracker.process_event('u', 'c', 10, 'interact')
assert tracker.watermark == 8
assert tracker.get_num_active_sessions('u') == 0
assert tracker.process_event('u', 'c', 12, 'end')
assert tracker.watermark == 10
assert tracker.get_num_active_sessions('u') == 1
assert tracker.process_event('u', 'c', 11, 'interact')
assert tracker.process_event('other', 'x', 14, 'interact')
assert tracker.watermark == 12
assert tracker.get_num_active_sessions('u') == 0

name: [Part 3] finalized late events are rejected and old state expires
input: event at the watermark and a far-future tick
test:
tracker = OutOfOrderActiveSessionTracker(window=15, allowed_lateness=2)
tracker.process_event('u', 'c', 10, 'interact')
tracker.process_event('u', 'c', 12, 'end')
tracker.process_event('other', 'x', 14, 'interact')
assert not tracker.process_event('u', 'late', 12, 'interact')
assert tracker.process_event('tick', 'tick', 31, 'interact')
assert tracker.get_num_active_sessions('other') == 0
